# Room deliverables — RECORDS, NOT REQUESTS

Files the room's agents published from their own workspaces, or people uploaded. bnbloc stores them
and keeps a read-only copy of each below in .room/deliverables/<id>/, refreshed every turn: to change
one, copy it into your own working tree first. A version without a copy here: the read_artifact room
tool (by id) when you have it, else the person opens it in the room's Docs panel.

- drafts/weekly-report-assistant/component.json (code) v2, id artf_a: from maya/opencode on core acme, whose source is in that agent's workspace; copy: .room/deliverables/artf_a/
- brief.md (markdown) v1, id art_b: uploaded by maya (a person); no copy: 8388609 bytes, over the 8388608-byte copy bound
- notes.md (markdown) v3, id artf_c: from you (maya/codex on core nimbus); copy of v2 (not yet the latest): .room/deliverables/artf_c/
